summary: One-shot, privacy-first offline GTCRN crash diagnosis with isolated native process and Android exit categories, without changing live dictation.

changes.title: One-shot private voice crash check in BR Brain
changes.detail: A new explicit Run one private check button tests the bundled GTCRN engine with synthetic audio in a separate Android process. It cannot open the microphone and cannot run automatically; the keyboard stays in its crash-safe Parakeet mode. A 20-second hard watchdog terminates a stalled probe without keeping a model running in the background.

changes.title: Useful crash categories without private logs
changes.detail: Android process-exit history can show a previous keyboard native/Java crash or memory pressure, and the isolated check reports its last processing stage and exit category. No raw tombstones, typed text, transcripts, recordings or app identities are saved.

changes.title: Controlled erasure and user sharing
changes.detail: The tiny diagnostic status is kept only in app-private no-backup storage, with an explicit copy-safe-result action and erase button. No background telemetry or network permission was added.

changes.title: Parakeet Ultra stays gated
changes.detail: The contemplated 0.6B/600–700 MB Parakeet migration awaits measured Indian-English accuracy and Oppo memory/latency results. Existing Parakeet model, signed update identity and everyday typing remain unchanged.
